donor_semantics: pointer file when it names an existing file -> AGENTZERO_DB/UDB_DB_PATH -> XDG data unified.db when present -> existing legacy STERN_DIR/unified.db -> XDG target for fresh install
non_overlap_note: Phase-0 F2-WP-001/002/003/004/005 lanes are active in parallel. This claim is restricted to the Phase-1 state identity primitive and does not edit their files or claims.

fingerprint distinguishes missing, non-regular and exact regular-file identity

hashing detects file mutation during fingerprinting and fails closed
